name: Bort (DCS-BIOS Reference Tool)
summary: Desktop UI and testing tool for browsing and testing DCS-BIOS controls.
description: Bort is an Electron app that replaces the old Chrome-app DCS-BIOS reference tool, letting you look up and test DCS-BIOS controls per aircraft. It is a separate program with its own installer (Windows, Linux, macOS builds).

releases.changelog: Linux JSON loading fix, version dialog, removed Openbeta channel, control attributes and colours.
